Name: Artaxerxes
Summary: King of Persia who first stopped Jerusalem's rebuilding, then authorized Ezra's return and Nehemiah's wall-building, and whose twentieth year dates Nehemiah's commission.
KeyVerses: Ezra 4:7; Ezra 4:8; Ezra 4:11; Ezra 4:23; Ezra 6:14; Ezra 7:1; Ezra 7:7; Ezra 7:11; Ezra 7:12; Ezra 7:21; Ezra 8:1; Nehemiah 2:1; Nehemiah 5:14; Nehemiah 13:6
LifeLesson: The same throne that hindered can later help; God turns kings' hearts.
RelatedEvents: Rebuilding of the Temple; Nehemiah Rebuilds the Wall
